Transitive through Expo asset processing at build time, on images committed to this repository. The app decodes no untrusted image dimensions. Advisory: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop

Two copies, neither reachable from the app. node_modules/zod 4.6.7 is marked dev and is pulled in by eslint-plugin-react-hooks, knip and zod-validation-error -- lint and dead-code tooling, which parse this repository's own source and configuration. node_modules/expo/node_modules/zod 3.25.76 comes from @expo/cli and runs only while a build is produced. Nothing under src/ imports zod, so the shipped bundle contains no Zod validator and no oversized collection reaches one. The dev copy is past the 4.6.6 fix, but the advisory stays reported until Expo's nested 3.x copy moves: npm's only offered fix is expo 51.0.39, a semver-major downgrade from the SDK 55 this project is on. Advisory: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
